services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Whatever your swim ability or swimming goal, our swim instructors are here to help you achieve what you want. By giving students the opportunity to master one element before moving on to the next, our swim classes make it easy to build confidence in the water. Lessons vary from 30-45 minutes long depending on the age of the student. Lessons run on a monthly basis. Designed for children ages 3 to 5 years and 6 months old working on building their water safety skills like bobs, floating, and learning to move arms and legs simultaneously in the water. services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Hampton Virginia Aquaplex is not responsible for any lost or stolen items. Lockers are available for use both inside and at the Splashdown Park. Locks are not provided. Children over the age of 5 years are not permitted in locker rooms of the opposite sex. Family changing rooms are available for use. During scheduled swim and dive meets, only participating athletes are allowed in the locker rooms. The men and women’s restrooms adjacent to the locker rooms, are for public use during meets. Only United States Coast Guard approved personal flotation “jackets” and “puddle jumpers” are permitted at the Hampton VA Aquaplex and Splashdown Park.
